description: Read any EVM chain through Blockscout, the open-source block explorer behind Ethereum, Optimism, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis, zkSync and a hundred more. Look up an address's balance, tokens, NFTs and history, follow a transaction with its decoded method call and events, read blocks, tokens, holders and verified contract source, and search a chain by name, address or hash. One PRO API key from dev.blockscout.com reaches every chain, and the free plan covers all but Base, Polygon and zkSync; each step picks its chain from a dropdown. Amounts come back in raw units and whole coins, gas in gwei and timestamps as dates, and every address carries the name, ENS and labels Blockscout knows it by.
